name: Juegos para móvil
description: Crea juegos para móvil: controles táctiles, juego instalable (PWA) y APK de Android con Capacitor. Sin cuentas ni créditos.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Mobile readiness of the open game: which mobile files exist (touch controls, PWA manifest, Android build script) and whether index.html and src/main.js are wired. Read the mobile-games skill first.

tools.name: prepare
tools.description: Write the mobile kit into the open game: src/touch-controls.js (virtual joystick, drag-to-look and buttons feeding ctx.keys/ctx.look through __studio.injectInput), manifest.webmanifest (installable PWA), docs/MOBILE.md and docs/build-android.ps1 (Capacitor APK). Existing files are kept unless overwrite is true. Afterwards wire them into index.html and src/main.js as the returned guide says.

name.description: The game's title, shown on the phone's home screen.

appId.description: Optional Android application id such as com.author.game.

overwrite.description: Replace mobile files that already exist.

skills.name: mobile-games
skills.summary: Read when the user wants a game for phones or tablets (juego de móvil, Android, APK, PWA, controles táctiles): how to prepare touch controls, the installable PWA and the Android build, and how to make it run well on a phone.

actions.name: help
actions.label: Cómo crear un juego de móvil
